newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA CAPTAIN PINTO SIGNS "FOR LIFE".
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA CAPTAIN PINTO SIGNS "FOR LIFE".

text.p: Benfica captain Joao Vieira Pinto, the subject of multi-million dollar transfer offers, on Friday signed a contract "for life" with the Portuguese club.
Chairman Manuel Damasio told a news conference the 25-year-old international striker had agreed to remain at Benfica for the rest of his career.
Vieira Pinto, the most prominent Portuguese player still in the domestic league, has been with Benfica since 1992. His present contract expired in 2000.
Since the Bosman ruling came into force last year a flood of Portuguese players have been transferred abroad, particularly to Spain and Italy where fees and wages are higher.
Damasio said recently that a vote of the entire Benfica membership would be needed for Vieira Pinto to be allowed to leave.
